mapper.select:
select C.contract_no as contractNo, C.employee_no as employeeNo, A.account_name as employeeName, C.employee_signature as employeeSignature, C.employer_signature as employerSignature
from employment_contract C
join employee E on C.employee_no = E.employee_no
join account A on E.account_no = A.account_no
where C.contract_status = 'pending'
order by C.contract_start asc, C.contract_no asc

SELECT C.contract_no AS contractNo, C.employee_no AS employeeNo, A.account_name AS employeeName, C.contract_end AS contractEnd,
TRUNC(CAST(C.contract_end AS DATE)) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS dDay
FROM employment_contract C
JOIN employee E ON C.employee_no = E.employee_no
JOIN account A ON E.account_no = A.account_no
WHERE C.contract_status = 'active'
AND C.contract_end IS NOT NULL
AND C.contract_end BETWEEN SYSTIMESTAMP AND SYSTIMESTAMP + 7
ORDER BY C.contract_end ASC

select X.payroll_no as payrollNo, X.employee_no as employeeNo, A.account_name as employeeName, X.payroll_year as payrollYear, X.payroll_month as payrollMonth, X.payday as payday,
greatest( X.net_pay - nvl(PP.paid_amount, 0) + nvl(PP.cancelled_amount, 0), 0 ) as netPay,
case when ( X.net_pay - nvl(PP.paid_amount, 0) + nvl(PP.cancelled_amount, 0) ) > 0 then 'unpaid' else 'paid' end as paymentStatus
from (
select P.payroll_no, P.employee_no, P.payroll_year, P.payroll_month, P.net_pay, C.contract_no, C.payday,
row_number() over ( partition by P.payroll_no order by max(S.scheduled_work_date) desc, C.contract_no desc ) as rn
from payroll P
join employment_contract C on P.employee_no = C.employee_no
join employee_work_schedule S on C.contract_no = S.contract_no
where extract(year from S.scheduled_work_date) = P.payroll_year
and extract(month from S.scheduled_work_date) = P.payroll_month
group by P.payroll_no, P.employee_no, P.payroll_year, P.payroll_month, P.net_pay, C.contract_no, C.payday
) X
join employee E on X.employee_no = E.employee_no
join account A on E.account_no = A.account_no
left join (
select payroll_no,
sum( case when payment_status = 'paid' then payment_amount else 0 end ) as paid_amount,
sum( case when payment_status = 'cancelled' then payment_amount else 0 end ) as cancelled_amount
from payroll_payment
group by payroll_no
) PP on X.payroll_no = PP.payroll_no
where X.rn = 1
and ( X.net_pay - nvl(PP.paid_amount, 0) + nvl(PP.cancelled_amount, 0) ) > 0
